items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Stock button with a hand-drawn ink outline and solid ink fill (needs ink-frame), plus an sfx variant.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Stock badge with a hand-drawn ink outline (needs ink-frame) and a spot variant for the one red label.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Stock separator drawn as one hand-drawn ink stroke (needs ink-frame).

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: One manga panel: heavy hand-drawn ink frame on paper, optional screentone, corner caption and hatched shadow (needs ink-frame).

items.name: panel-grid
items.title: Panel Grid
items.description: Manga page layout: panels on a grid with paper gutters, column and row spans, one column on phones.

items.name: speech-bubble
items.title: Speech Bubble
items.description: Dialogue bubble with a hand-drawn tail: round, square, shout burst or dashed whisper, seven tail positions (needs ink-frame).

items.name: thought-bubble
items.title: Thought Bubble
items.description: Dashed hand-drawn thought bubble with a trail of one to three rough ink dots (needs ink-frame).

items.name: sfx-text
items.title: SFX Text
items.description: Onomatopoeia in the display face with ink stroke, hard shadow, tilt and a reduced-motion-safe pop or slam entrance.

items.name: vertical-text
items.title: Vertical Text
items.description: Vertical writing (vertical-rl) with text-orientation control for mixing Japanese and Latin.

items.name: manga-frame
items.title: Manga Frame
items.description: Image in a hand-drawn ink frame with aspect presets, a halftone mat and a caption; alt is required (needs ink-frame).
